create.title: Target-sized positive-line compact beta terminal and artificial residue
create.statement_tex: After the complete finite product Cauchy--Green sum is returned to the positive-a, positive-b endpoint-free beta representative, multiply by psi(beta)chi_0(alpha), with b=1/log(2X), 0<=a<=b, a+b<1/2, and a/2+b<1/4. The central terminal is exactly the three-selector functional: j=0 singular u^(-1) under the signed normalized Plemelj distribution, j=0 regular top under ordinary mu integration, and j>=1 interior profiles under ordinary mu integration, with every actual floor, star, equality convention, chi_4, profile, and scale retained. Its amplitude satisfies sup_(1<=x<=N_X)(|A_db(x)|+x|A_db'(x)|)=O(log^C(2X)); the accepted radial-BV reduction therefore gives physical O(X^(1/4)log^C(2X)) with full continuous radial endpoint coefficients. At rho=1/4-s-v/2=0, the local s-residue is +pi i sqrt(X) I_1(0)=e(sqrt(XN_X))-e(sqrt(X)). Keeping zeta(3/4+u/2+v)L(3/4-u/2,chi_4) recombined, both the chi_0(mu/2) and 1-chi_0(mu/2) artificial shares are O(log^C(2X)) normalized, by compact beta height, signed Plemelj at mu=0, period-four Abel summation, and cubic height decay. The external -(4/pi)X^(1/4)Re(e(1/8) dot) operator is owned once. This lemma does not identify or estimate the direct large-alpha complement.
